Global warming contributions from fossil fuels and land use
1851 to 2024

Global mean surface temperature change driven by a country or region's cumulative
fossil-fuel
and
land-use

change
emissions of three gases – carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide.
Note: This does not include cooling impacts from sulphur dioxide and aerosols, so the net warming can be lower.
